nodes.name: Post alert (Discord webhook)
nodes.notes: Set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL in the n8n environment to a Discord incoming webhook URL (Server Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks) - never hardcode it here or commit it. Same webhook the API's own new-tender alerts use (apps/api/src/lib/discord.ts), so both land in one channel. Swapping to Slack/Teams later just means changing the body key from "content" to "text" - Discord and Slack/Teams incoming webhooks are otherwise interchangeable but not field-compatible.
